description: A railing with pipes along a seeded path. The path is a level polyline that winds forward (each heading within 90° of +X, so it never crosses itself), its segments sized so that, once every corner is rounded with corner_radius, it is exactly path_length long. Posts stand evenly along it, at most post_spacing apart, both ends included, each on a base plate and carrying pipe arms; the handrail (its top at rail_height) and a knee rail are swept along the rounded path. Each pipe is an offset of the sharp path on the right side, stacked in rows on the arms (a second column when the rows do not fit under the handrail), with every corner rounded concentric to the railing's (corner_radius plus or minus its distance, never tighter than two pipe radii), so it keeps its distance around the bends.

corner_radius.label: corner radius
corner_radius.desc: radius of the path's rounded corners (m); 0 = sharp corners

post_spacing.label: post spacing
post_spacing.desc: largest distance between two posts (m); the posts are spread evenly

rail_height.label: rail height
rail_height.desc: height of the top of the handrail above the path (m)

pipes.label: pipes
pipes.desc: pipes running beside the railing on its right side

seed.label: seed
seed.desc: random seed of the path's turns

params.code:
// straight distance to the next post along the path
f@gap = @ptnum + 1 < @numpt ? distance(@P, point(0, 'P', @ptnum + 1)) : 0;

pipes_closed.note: assert watertight fails on empty geometry ("no polygons"), so with pipes 0 this checks closed through expr instead; use watertight once an empty mesh passes it.

params.label: closed
params.expr: pipes == 0 ? nprims == 0 : closed && open_pieces == 0 && pieces == pipes

railing.label: Railing
railing.description: Posts on base plates with pipe arms, a handrail and a knee rail along the path, in painted steel.

pipes.label: Pipes
pipes.description: The copper pipes on the right of the railing, bending with it at a constant distance (empty when pipes is 0).

path.label: Path
path.description: The level path with rounded corners that the railing and the pipes follow, exactly path_length long.
